data.title: Europol says quantum computing won't break Bitcoin, but some wallets are exposed
data.description: Europe's top police agency has weighed in on crypto's favorite doomsday scenario. Its verdict: the sky is not falling.On October 7, 2026, Europol's European Cybercrime Centre (EC3) published two reports on how quantum computing could affect crypto and encrypted data.
